phase: CPU coverage before any new intervention
source: saved complete native RC14 eight engineering trajectories; exposed, not independent

arithmetic.rule: Only complete exact integer/rational + - * / equations in delimited math or whole lines; false equality in immediately completed step can release next clean negative-R lexical window
arithmetic.eligibility: At least 2 different questions with an actionable site; every selected first site must be a genuine asserted error under prefix-only manual review, not quotation/reductio/case split
arithmetic.scope: No varying-variable inconsistency heuristic, no generic prompt, no correction token forcing

boundary.rule: Causal decoded suffix blank line plus horizontal whitespace; compare with original single-token-boundary opening
boundary.eligibility: At least 2 different questions with a newly actionable negative-R opening; no suppression of already accepted mixed boundary+word tokens
boundary.scope: No expanding trigger dictionary; no retrospective edits

stop: If coverage or assertion validity fails, stop this fixed rule; no threshold widening on these 8 cases. Coverage alone never proves benefit.
GPU: Not yet authorized by this plan for efficacy; user authorizes exploration but concrete generation batch to be specified if gate passes.
